summary: {shopper} turns over a hearing-aid box to see whether it contains the batteries needed to use it.
realLife: After commenters asked to compare models and buy any needed batteries on the same trip, FDA required the outer package to identify their type, quantity and inclusion.

turns.what: The clerk checks the battery compartment against the box.
turns.writesBack: The shopper adds their price before comparing two models.

turns.what: The package lists a full starter set.
turns.writesBack: The buyer can take the package home without a second purchase.
